about: Facts behind rights_matrix.csv. analysis/prelaunch.rights_status() turns them into a status: blocked_reasons > missing evidence (terms_verified / plan_known / provenance_complete) > clarify > conditions. Terms read 2026-10-27; see evidence_ledger.csv for URLs and dates.

sounds.intended_use: soundtrack of monetized long-form YouTube videos
sounds.evidence: Music Terms (updated 2026-10-09) Exhibit A: Starter and above permit online commercial use except film/TV/radio/studio games; Free is personal use and cannot download - files exist, so a paid plan at download is likely (INFERRED). Owner says Creator; no invoice or generation history seen.
sounds.missing_provenance: ElevenLabs generation IDs, prompts, settings, plan on 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-26; the _ORIGINALS carry an ffmpeg encoder tag (Lavf63), so they may be re-encoded rather than the untouched downloads
clarify: Content ID / distributor registration of Creator-plan output (Terms silent; output may not be unique - ToS s10)
no IP warranty or indemnity on self-serve plans (ToS s10-11) - accept the risk knowingly
conditions: turn on YouTube's altered/synthetic disclosure (AI music is the main focus)
no music library, free-for-streamers offer, downloads or sample packs (Music Terms s4.2)
do not remove ElevenLabs provenance signals (Use Policy s10)

originals.intended_use: archive of the generated originals (not published)
originals.evidence: Same as the published tracks; kept as the reference for any dispute.
originals.missing_provenance: generation IDs and dates from the ElevenLabs history page; proof these are the untouched downloads

images.provider: ChatGPT image generation (OpenAI), edited in Photoshop
images.intended_use: video frame, overlay and thumbnail art
images.evidence: OpenAI Terms of Use (effective 2026-01-01): 'you ... own the Output', rights assigned 'if any'; output 'may not be unique'; Service Terms s6: no likeness of a real person without consent - the character is fictional.
images.missing_provenance: prompts, generation dates and the original PNGs as downloaded (Content Credentials are lost through edits and screenshots)
conditions: keep the character fictional - do not present him as Yasuke or any real person
do not claim the art is hand-made

videos.intended_use: the 6-second breathing loop repeated through each video
videos.evidence: Kling paid-service terms (effective 2026-10-10) s3.1.2: members' commercial use of Output 'is not restricted' during the membership; ToS (2026-04-21) s4.6: otherwise commercial use needs written permission; free-tier output must carry Kling branding.
videos.missing_provenance: membership start date vs the clip's creation (2026-10-22), prompt, source image, credits used
clarify: whether commercial rights in clips made during the Pro membership survive cancellation ('during the Validity Period of your Membership')

fonts.provider: Google Fonts families under the SIL Open Font License (licence files present)
fonts.intended_use: quote typography rendered into the video
fonts.evidence: OFL text present next to every font file; the OFL allows use in any document or video, including commercial.
conditions: do not sell or redistribute the font files themselves

blocked_reasons: the file as-is presents 9 modern authors' lines and 3 known misattributions as 'samurai wisdom' - see the per-quote rows

renders.provider: Seamless-app render of the assets above
renders.evidence: A render inherits the strictest status of what it contains.
renders.missing_provenance: inherits the music and Kling provenance gaps

conditions: local playlist only - not published; its file name is a 2017 film title, so don't reuse that name publicly

vlcsnap-.provider: screenshot of the owner's Kling video
clarify: inherits the Kling question (clip rights after cancellation)
vlcsnap-.missing_provenance: which clip and frame; inherits the Kling gaps

roller\\.(png|psd)$.missing_provenance: how the scroll was made (prompt/date) - not recorded

blocked_reasons: burns in the quote set, which contains blocked quotes (modern authors and misattributions presented as samurai wisdom)

conditions: credit as a paraphrase of the named work (Musashi / Hagakure)
credit the real (non-samurai) source or drop it

blocked_reasons: a modern author's line presented as samurai wisdom (misattribution; may be protected)
a widely circulated misattribution - rewrite or replace with a real proverb

conditions: present as original reflections, not as quotations
native-speaker check of the Japanese (several lines are English idioms calqued)
ORIGINAL/GENERIC.evidence: No source found; reads as AI-written. Google Terms (effective 2026-07-30): 'Google won't claim ownership over that content'.
